name: Deb Patterson

bio.statement: In her pamphlet statement, Patterson lists her occupation as State Senator, with a background as ordained clergy and executive director of the International Parish Nurse Resource Center.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: State Senator Occupational Background: Ordained clergy; Executive Director, International Parish Nurse Resource Center; Vice President, Deaconess Foundation

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Marion/Polk edition (Book 8), p. 41

bio.statement: Patterson's official legislative page says she represents Senate District 10.
bio.excerpt: I'm proud to represent Senate District 10.

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature, Senator Deb Patterson home page

bio.statement: Patterson's official biography describes her as an advocate for healthcare for all, public education for all ages and climate action.
bio.excerpt: She is a strong advocate for healthcare for all, for public education for all ages, and for climate action.

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature, Senator Deb Patterson biography

positions.statement: Patterson says she is fighting for working families by closing tax loopholes for wealthy corporations and expanding a tax credit for 200,000 low-income Oregon families.
positions.excerpt: Fighting for working families by closing Trump’s tax loopholes for wealthy corporations and expanding a tax credit for 200,000 low-income Oregon families.

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Marion/Polk edition (Book 8), p. 41

positions.statement: Patterson says she is working to reduce costs by taking on utility companies to lower rates.
positions.excerpt: Reducing costs by taking on utility companies to lower rates and holding big corporations responsible for raising prices to pad their profits.

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Marion/Polk edition (Book 8), p. 41

positions.statement: Patterson says she is working to make healthcare more affordable by capping the price of essential medications and protecting access to healthcare.
positions.excerpt: Making healthcare more affordable by taking on Big Pharma to cap the price of essential medications and protecting access to healthcare for over one million Oregonians.

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Marion/Polk edition (Book 8), p. 41

positions.statement: Patterson says she is championing investments in public schools and pushing for smaller classes.
positions.excerpt: Championing historic investments in public schools, pushing for smaller classes, and ensuring that funds are spent improving educational outcomes for our children.

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Marion/Polk edition (Book 8), p. 41

positions.statement: Patterson says she is addressing homelessness by securing funding for affordable housing, public safety and resources to improve quality of life.
positions.excerpt: Addressing homelessness by securing funding for affordable housing, public safety, and the needed resources to improve quality of life for all Oregonians.

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Marion/Polk edition (Book 8), p. 41

collection_notes: Statement is the LEFT column of Book8 p. 41 (Plowhead is the right column). The same page also appears in Book9. Environment limit: WebFetch reaches only .gov hosts (news/third-party hosts fail with ENOTFOUND), so steps 3, 5 and 6 produced no fetched material; steps 4-5 searches were run for every candidate in SD3-SD11 with identical queries. Items are T1 (pamphlet and oregonlegislature.gov member pages). Incumbency set true only because the official member page states the Senator represents the district; inventory agrees.
